sloka: यदि वा सहनीयं ते मामनुज्ञातुमर्हसि ।क्षम त्वं न क्षमिष्ये ऽहं मरिष्यामि न संशयः ।। ७.५८.१४ ॥
transliteration: yadi vā sahanīyaṁ te māmanujñātumarhasi ।kṣama tvaṁ na kṣamiṣye 'haṁ mariṣyāmi na saṁśayaḥ ।। 7.58.14 ॥

translations.english: Yadu continued, "If this is bearable for you, then you should permit me; you may endure it, but I will not, and I will surely die."
